components.label: Spire Legacy for Slay the Spire 2, BaseLib and local content reader

notes.beforeInstall: Requires owned Steam installations of Slay the Spire 2 regular branch v0.107.1 or a compatible later version and Rogue Legacy 2. Includes BaseLib 3.4.7. No game content is included. This Melty launcher mapping targets Windows; the Workshop package also supports native Linux and Steam Deck.
notes.firstLaunch: Accept the game's mod notice and enable BaseLib and Spire Legacy. Choose The Heir; Family Manor & Heir Lab appears above the Heir portrait; press Y to open it. The first family run jumps into a fight. All later runs use normal maps and events.
